values.description: Full URL of your AppDynamics controller (no trailing slash). Example: https://mycompany.saas.appdynamics.com
AppDynamics account name. Found in Settings > License > Account. Example: customer1
AppDynamics login username (without @account suffix). Example: admin
AppDynamics user password or API client secret
Numeric AppDynamics application ID. Obtain from the List Applications response (the 'id' field). Example: 14
Your Dynatrace environment URL (no trailing slash). SaaS example: https://abc12345.live.dynatrace.com — Managed example: https://myserver/e/ENVIRONMENT-ID
Dynatrace API token. Generate in Dynatrace under Settings > Access Tokens. Required scopes: problems.read, entities.read, metrics.read, logs.read, events.read
